venue_coverage: IEX Exchange only (top-of-book quotes and trades on IEX). Not consolidated: IEX BBO is not the NBBO and IEX volume is a fraction of total U.S. volume. OTC securities not covered.
entitlement: Free historical data under the IEX Historical Data Terms of Use; attribution required; reference use only
latency_note: Historical file published by IEX after the trading day; replayed with as-of gating (no live latency).
adjustments: Raw unadjusted exchange prices (no split/dividend adjustment). Corporate actions on the replay day are not adjusted.
attribution: Data provided for free by IEX. By accessing or using IEX Historical Data, you agree to the IEX Historical Data Terms of Use (https://www.iex.io/legal/hist-data-terms).
notes: Stored symbols: price < $5 observed at any time (storage superset), large-cap reference list, benchmark ETFs.
